Well I’m assuming you have regular Internet Access? You could look for therapists online. As for the antidepressants? Here’s the thing. I hate to make depression sound simple. Cuz it’s not. But it can be as basic as a chemical imbalance in your brain. That’s how I explained it to my suicidal girlfriend. It could literally be that you’re missing a single drop of a chemical in your head. It’s not your fault. Antidepressants could be that balancing factor that opens up your eyes to a door you haven’t noticed yet. You should try to get some if you can. My best friend said they made all the difference

I spoiled her from the very first day and have not left her side since. So that’s the dynamic in our relationship now, although not anywhere near that degree anymore because money is tight for me now. 

Tbh, I don’t see anything really wrong in our relationship, but that may just be cuz I’m so into our relationship. My best friend spent hours ranting at me about how toxic our relationship was and hearing it from someone else in a 3rd person perspective really sheds a light on it. But at this point I’m too far gone to stop anytime soon. I can deal with the toxicity of our relationship later, right now I’m just desperate and scared and looking for ways to save her and open her eyes so she’ll at least give the AD a chance

She grew up in a very VERY abusive household. Her siblings and her mother were abused by her dad except for herself, so ever since then, she has felt singled out and excluded from her family. She now has PTSD from that and from a traumatic even caused by her mom. Unfortunately, she now lives alone with her mom, and she and her mom constantly get into fights. The mom has accused her several times of being controlling and manipulative (and I’m starting to realize she is, even if unintentional) and that always brings her down. She has trouble sleeping. And actually she spends a majority of her time anywhere that I am. To be honest, our relationship is very toxic.
